sources.observed: Rate limiting is available on all plans. Hobby/Pro use fixed windows with IP and JA4 keys; counters are regional. Hobby lists 1M included allowed requests; Pro is usage-based. Pricing shown as $0.50 per 1M allowed requests.
Denied, challenged, or rate-limited traffic does not incur CDN Requests/Fast Data Transfer; rate limiting itself remains a priced feature billed by allowed requests.
Pricing table lists 1M monthly firewall rate-limit requests included on Hobby and usage-based pricing starting at $0.50 per 1M on Pro. Account plan and actual quota were not inspected.

Vercel waives CDN request and Fast Data Transfer charges for requests denied, challenged, or rate-limited by its firewall. This does not say WAF feature charges or third-party Gemini charges are waived.

change: Updated docs/rag/VERCEL_RATE_LIMITER_RUNBOOK.md with current plan/price distinctions, the CDN/FDT waiver nuance, and the fact that regional counters are not a global cap.
limitations: Public docs do not reveal this project's selected plan, quota, regional traffic, rate rule, or billing configuration.
Regional fixed-window counters can allow aggregate traffic above a single region's threshold.
Vercel ingress limiting does not establish a Gemini quota, provider spend cap, or hard global request limit.
